notes.title: Introduction of my next game Wendigo Hunter
notes.notes:
Hello fans and followers of Juro Janosik game. 

I wanted to share with you some information about my next game I am working on.

It's called [b]Wendigo Hunter[/b] and it is an action roguelite dungeon crawler with mysterious atmosphere and minimalistic visual. As a chosen member of a cult you will try to hunt down a mythological creature Wendigo hiding deep in dungeons and abandoned ruins.

I started working on it in January 2022 and I think it's now somewhere between prototype and vertical slice phase. So there is still a lot of work to be done. My plan is to have a playable demo in Q4 2024 and then release the game as Early Access (hopefully in the end of 2024).

The game has a Steam page so you can already add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326040/?utm_source=JuroSteamPage

I am very happy to announce that this game will be supported using public funding by Slovak Arts Council (same as my previous game Juro Janosik). Thank you!

I can't wait to see you playing my next game!
Peter from Black Deer Games

notes.title: 3rd place in Developer Contest at Game Days 2022 in Kosice, Slovakia
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that Juro Janosik won 3rd place in Developer Contest at Game Days 2022 conference in Kosice, Slovakia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34515378/90b6e7e47bd3b271b9b6a7b84be441d4314f1a8e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Juro Janosik wins The Best Game award in GAME ACCESS '22 CONFERENCE in Brno, CZ.
notes.notes:
Hi all, last weekend I have presented my Juro Janosik game at the [url=https://game-access.com/conference/]GAME ACCESS CONFERENCE '22[/url] in Brno, Czech Republic besides other almost 60 indie games from other developers and studios. I am very happy to announce that I managed to win The Best Game award.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34515378/d9fd37e352c9d3c5f8f16430edafc816b2db89c3.jpg[/img]

I would like to thank everyone who came to my stand throughout the event. Many thanks also to the organizers for their great work. I am looking forward to next year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34515378/9d74bd0afa5a9ee3f572666665b4f20317065073.png[/img]

notes.title: Slovak game of the year 2021 on Sector.sk
notes.notes:
Great news! Juro Janosik wins in category "Slovak game of the year 2021" in big survey on [url=https://www.sector.sk/clanok/37773/citatelska-hra-roka-2021.htm]Sector.sk[/url] gaming portal. Whoaa 37% of all people voted for my game ːsteamhappyː. What a great number. Thank you for every vote for my game! ːsteamthumbsupː
